consume-without-group.json.rule: a consumed entry names its consumer group (Q5)

invented-class.json.rule: an author-, source- or client-scope deletion has no class to copy (F-42, D-1)

not-own-dlq.json.rule: each service writes its own dlq.<service> (CONVENTIONS v1.1 L41)

null-class-copied.json.rule: a class is copied only from an original that has a valid one (F-42, D-1)

null-route-not-a-deletion.json.rule: a null route is copied only from an author-, source- or client-scope deletion (F-42, D-1)

produce-with-offset.json.rule: a produce-side entry has no consumed offset (F-21)

provenance-not-copied.json.rule: a data message's provenance is copied to the top (F-42)

provenance-not-the-messages.json.rule: the copied provenance equals the message's (F-42)

raw-with-provenance.json.rule: provenance is copied only from a parsed data message (F-42)

zero-attempts.json.rule: a dead letter failed at least once
